mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.region_id AS region_id, dt.name, di.image_url, cc.region_name AS region_name, d.season, NULL AS category_id, NULL AS category_name FROM destinations d LEFT JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN destination_images di ON d.id = di.destination_id AND di.is_main = 1 LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id WHERE d.season = #{season} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM categories WHERE id = #{categoryId}
